question_fa: داشبورد تغییر جهانی eating_disorder: میانگین، صدک‌های تقریبی و بیشترین تغییر کشورها را بده.
sql: WITH endpoints AS (SELECT country_name, MAX(CASE WHEN year = 1990 THEN prevalence_pct END) AS value_1990, MAX(CASE WHEN year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM country_prevalence_long) THEN prevalence_pct END) AS value_latest FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE disorder = 'eating_disorder' AND is_country_like = 1 GROUP BY country_name), changes AS (SELECT country_name, value_1990, value_latest, value_latest - value_1990 AS change_pct_point FROM endpoints WHERE value_1990 IS NOT NULL AND value_latest IS NOT NULL), ranked AS (SELECT *, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY change_pct_point) AS change_quartile FROM changes) SELECT change_quartile, COUNT(*) AS country_count, ROUND(AVG(change_pct_point), 3) AS avg_change, ROUND(MIN(change_pct_point), 3) AS min_change, ROUND(MAX(change_pct_point), 3) AS max_change FROM ranked GROUP BY change_quartile ORDER BY change_quartile;

question_fa: ماتریس خواب و رژیم غذایی برای افسردگی و CGPA بساز.
sql: SELECT sleep_duration_category,dietary_habits,COUNT(*) AS n,ROUND(100.0*SUM(depression_flag)/COUNT(*),2) AS depression_rate_pct,ROUND(AVG(cgpa_10),2) AS avg_cgpa FROM student_depression WHERE sleep_duration_category IS NOT NULL AND dietary_habits IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sleep_duration_category,dietary_habits HAVING COUNT(*)>=50 ORDER BY depression_rate_pct DESC;
storytelling_hint_fa: نمونه پیچیده برای dashboard/storytelling و guardrailهای تحلیلی.

question_fa: بهره‌وری پایین‌تر از معمول رو با ریسک سلامت روان مقایسه کن.
sql: WITH st AS (SELECT AVG(productivity_score) AS m, AVG(productivity_score*productivity_score)-AVG(productivity_score)*AVG(productivity_score) AS v FROM mental_health_general), f AS (SELECT mental_health_risk, stress_level, sleep_hours, (productivity_score-m)/SQRT(v) AS z FROM mental_health_general CROSS JOIN st WHERE v>0 AND productivity_score IS NOT NULL) SELECT CASE WHEN z<=-1 THEN 'low_productivity' ELSE 'others' END AS productivity_segment, mental_health_risk, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(stress_level),2) AS avg_stress, ROUND(AVG(sleep_hours),2) AS avg_sleep FROM f GROUP BY productivity_segment,mental_health_risk ORDER BY productivity_segment,n DESC;
storytelling_hint_fa: نمونه پیچیده برای dashboard/storytelling و guardrailهای تحلیلی.

question_fa: برای Germany، آخرین مقدار هر اختلال، رتبه جهانی آن و فاصله از میانگین جهانی را بساز.
sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT * FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE is_country_like = 1 AND year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM country_prevalence_long)), global_avg AS (SELECT disorder, AVG(prevalence_pct) AS avg_prevalence FROM latest GROUP BY disorder), ranked AS (SELECT disorder, country_name, prevalence_pct, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY disorder ORDER BY prevalence_pct DESC) AS global_rank FROM latest) SELECT r.disorder, ROUND(r.prevalence_pct, 3) AS country_prevalence_pct, r.global_rank, ROUND(g.avg_prevalence, 3) AS global_avg_prevalence_pct, ROUND(r.prevalence_pct - g.avg_prevalence, 3) AS gap_from_global_avg FROM ranked r JOIN global_avg g ON g.disorder = r.disorder WHERE r.country_name = 'Germany' ORDER BY country_prevalence_pct DESC;

question_fa: برای Italy، آخرین مقدار هر اختلال، رتبه جهانی آن و فاصله از میانگین جهانی را بساز.
sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT * FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE is_country_like = 1 AND year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM country_prevalence_long)), global_avg AS (SELECT disorder, AVG(prevalence_pct) AS avg_prevalence FROM latest GROUP BY disorder), ranked AS (SELECT disorder, country_name, prevalence_pct, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY disorder ORDER BY prevalence_pct DESC) AS global_rank FROM latest) SELECT r.disorder, ROUND(r.prevalence_pct, 3) AS country_prevalence_pct, r.global_rank, ROUND(g.avg_prevalence, 3) AS global_avg_prevalence_pct, ROUND(r.prevalence_pct - g.avg_prevalence, 3) AS gap_from_global_avg FROM ranked r JOIN global_avg g ON g.disorder = r.disorder WHERE r.country_name = 'Italy' ORDER BY country_prevalence_pct DESC;

question_fa: برای workplace شاخص امنیت روانی بساز و treatment rate بده.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT treatment,(CASE WHEN coworkers='Yes' THEN 1 WHEN coworkers='Some of them' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN supervisor='Yes' THEN 1 WHEN supervisor='Some of them' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN mental_health_consequence='No' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS safety_score FROM workplace_mental_health_survey) SELECT CASE WHEN safety_score<1 THEN 'low_safety' WHEN safety_score<2 THEN 'mid_safety' ELSE 'higher_safety' END AS safety_segment, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(safety_score),2) AS avg_safety_score, ROUND(100.0*SUM(treatment)/COUNT(*),2) AS treatment_rate_pct FROM s GROUP BY safety_segment ORDER BY avg_safety_score;
storytelling_hint_fa: نمونه پیچیده برای dashboard/storytelling و guardrailهای تحلیلی.

question_fa: برای United Kingdom، آخرین مقدار هر اختلال، رتبه جهانی آن و فاصله از میانگین جهانی را بساز.
sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT * FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE is_country_like = 1 AND year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM country_prevalence_long)), global_avg AS (SELECT disorder, AVG(prevalence_pct) AS avg_prevalence FROM latest GROUP BY disorder), ranked AS (SELECT disorder, country_name, prevalence_pct, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY disorder ORDER BY prevalence_pct DESC) AS global_rank FROM latest) SELECT r.disorder, ROUND(r.prevalence_pct, 3) AS country_prevalence_pct, r.global_rank, ROUND(g.avg_prevalence, 3) AS global_avg_prevalence_pct, ROUND(r.prevalence_pct - g.avg_prevalence, 3) AS gap_from_global_avg FROM ranked r JOIN global_avg g ON g.disorder = r.disorder WHERE r.country_name = 'United Kingdom' ORDER BY country_prevalence_pct DESC;

question_fa: برای Sweden، آخرین مقدار هر اختلال، رتبه جهانی و فاصله از میانگین جهانی را بساز.
sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT * FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE is_country_like = 1 AND year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM country_prevalence_long)), global_avg AS (SELECT disorder, AVG(prevalence_pct) AS avg_prevalence FROM latest GROUP BY disorder), ranked AS (SELECT disorder, country_name, prevalence_pct, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY disorder ORDER BY prevalence_pct DESC) AS global_rank FROM latest) SELECT r.disorder, ROUND(r.prevalence_pct, 3) AS country_prevalence_pct, r.global_rank, ROUND(g.avg_prevalence, 3) AS global_avg_prevalence_pct, ROUND(r.prevalence_pct - g.avg_prevalence, 3) AS gap_from_global_avg FROM ranked r JOIN global_avg g ON g.disorder = r.disorder WHERE r.country_name = 'Sweden' ORDER BY country_prevalence_pct DESC;

question_fa: در دیتاست عمومی، ترکیب خواب کم و استرس بالا چقدر بهره‌وری را نسبت به بقیه کاهش می‌دهد؟
sql: WITH segmented AS (SELECT CASE WHEN sleep_hours < 6 AND stress_level >= 8 THEN 'Low sleep + high stress' ELSE 'Others' END AS segment, productivity_score, depression_score, anxiety_score FROM mental_health_general), grouped AS (SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS total, AVG(productivity_score) AS avg_productivity, AVG(depression_score) AS avg_depression, AVG(anxiety_score) AS avg_anxiety FROM segmented GROUP BY segment), baseline AS (SELECT avg_productivity AS others_productivity FROM grouped WHERE segment = 'Others') SELECT g.segment, g.total, ROUND(g.avg_productivity, 2) AS avg_productivity, ROUND(g.avg_productivity - b.others_productivity, 2) AS productivity_gap_vs_others, ROUND(g.avg_depression, 2) AS avg_depression, ROUND(g.avg_anxiety, 2) AS avg_anxiety FROM grouped g CROSS JOIN baseline b ORDER BY g.avg_productivity;

question_fa: داستان سازمانی محیط کار: آیا مزایا، محرمانگی و آسانی مرخصی با درمان‌جویی بیشتر همراه‌اند؟
sql: SELECT benefits, anonymity, leave_difficulty, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(treatment) AS treatment_count, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(treatment) / COUNT(*), 2) AS treatment_rate_pct FROM workplace_mental_health_survey GROUP BY benefits, anonymity, leave_difficulty HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY treatment_rate_pct DESC LIMIT 30;

question_fa: داشبورد اولویت مداخله دانشجویان افسردگی بر اساس خواب را بساز.
sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT sleep_duration_category, COUNT(*) AS total, 100.0 * SUM(depression_flag) / COUNT(*) AS depression_rate_pct, 100.0 * SUM(suicidal_thoughts) / COUNT(*) AS suicidal_rate_pct, AVG(academic_pressure) AS avg_academic_pressure, AVG(cgpa_10) AS avg_cgpa FROM student_depression GROUP BY sleep_duration_category), scored AS (SELECT *, depression_rate_pct * 0.40 + suicidal_rate_pct * 0.35 + avg_academic_pressure * 10 * 0.25 AS intervention_priority_score FROM grouped) SELECT sleep_duration_category, total, ROUND(depression_rate_pct, 2) AS depression_rate_pct, ROUND(suicidal_rate_pct, 2) AS suicidal_rate_pct, ROUND(avg_academic_pressure, 2) AS avg_academic_pressure, ROUND(avg_cgpa, 2) AS avg_cgpa_10, ROUND(intervention_priority_score, 2) AS intervention_priority_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY intervention_priority_score DESC) AS priority_rank FROM scored ORDER BY priority_rank;

question_fa: کشورها را بر اساس هم‌زمانی شیوع افسردگی ملی و آمادگی سیاست محیط کار در سال ۲۰۱۴ تحلیل کن.
sql: WITH policy AS (SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS total, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN benefits = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS benefits_yes_rate, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN care_options = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS care_yes_rate FROM workplace_mental_health_survey WHERE country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY country HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10), prevalence AS (SELECT country_name, prevalence_pct AS depression_prevalence_pct FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE disorder = 'depression' AND year = 2014), joined AS (SELECT p.country, p.total, p.benefits_yes_rate, p.care_yes_rate, v.depression_prevalence_pct, (p.benefits_yes_rate + p.care_yes_rate) / 2 AS support_score FROM policy p JOIN prevalence v ON v.country_name = p.country) SELECT country, total, ROUND(depression_prevalence_pct, 2) AS depression_prevalence_pct, ROUND(support_score, 2) AS workplace_support_score, ROUND(support_score - depression_prevalence_pct, 2) AS support_minus_prevalence_gap FROM joined ORDER BY support_minus_prevalence_gap DESC;

question_fa: داشبورد سگمنت‌بندی دیتاست عمومی بر اساس محیط کار: سهم ریسک بالا، درمان‌جویی، افسردگی و بهره‌وری را بده.
sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT work_environment, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN mental_health_risk = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_risk_count, SUM(seeks_treatment) AS treatment_seekers, AVG(depression_score) AS avg_depression, AVG(anxiety_score) AS avg_anxiety, AVG(productivity_score) AS avg_productivity FROM mental_health_general GROUP BY work_environment), overall AS (SELECT AVG(productivity_score) AS overall_productivity FROM mental_health_general) SELECT work_environment, total, high_risk_count, ROUND(100.0 * high_risk_count / total, 2) AS high_risk_rate_pct, ROUND(100.0 * treatment_seekers / total, 2) AS treatment_rate_pct, ROUND(avg_depression, 2) AS avg_depression, ROUND(avg_anxiety, 2) AS avg_anxiety, ROUND(avg_productivity, 2) AS avg_productivity, ROUND(avg_productivity - overall_productivity, 2) AS productivity_gap_vs_overall FROM grouped CROSS JOIN overall ORDER BY high_risk_rate_pct DESC;

question_fa: ریموت بودن و policy score رو با هم کراس کن.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT remote_work,treatment,(CASE WHEN benefits='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN care_options='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN seek_help='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS score FROM workplace_mental_health_survey WHERE remote_work IS NOT NULL) SELECT remote_work, CASE WHEN score>=2 THEN 'stronger_policy' ELSE 'weaker_policy' END AS policy_segment, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(100.0*SUM(treatment)/COUNT(*),2) AS treatment_rate_pct FROM s GROUP BY remote_work,policy_segment ORDER BY remote_work DESC,treatment_rate_pct DESC;

question_fa: در دانشجویان افسردگی، ماتریس خواب و فشار تحصیلی را از نظر نرخ افسردگی بساز.
sql: WITH binned AS (SELECT CASE WHEN sleep_mid_hours IS NULL THEN 'Unknown' WHEN sleep_mid_hours < 4 THEN '<4' WHEN sleep_mid_hours < 6 THEN '4-6' WHEN sleep_mid_hours < 8 THEN '6-8' ELSE '8+' END AS x_bucket, CASE WHEN academic_pressure IS NULL THEN 'Unknown' WHEN academic_pressure < 2 THEN '<2' WHEN academic_pressure < 4 THEN '2-4' ELSE '4+' END AS y_bucket, depression_flag, cgpa_10 FROM student_depression) SELECT x_bucket, y_bucket, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(depression_flag) / COUNT(*), 2) AS depression_rate_pct, ROUND(AVG(cgpa_10), 2) AS avg_cgpa_10 FROM binned GROUP BY x_bucket, y_bucket HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY x_bucket, y_bucket;

question_fa: ریسک‌ها رو برای کسانی بده که استرس بالاتر از میانگین و خواب پایین‌تر از میانگین دارن.
sql: SELECT mental_health_risk, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(stress_level),2) AS avg_stress, ROUND(AVG(sleep_hours),2) AS avg_sleep FROM mental_health_general WHERE stress_level>(SELECT AVG(stress_level) FROM mental_health_general) AND sleep_hours<(SELECT AVG(sleep_hours) FROM mental_health_general) GROUP BY mental_health_risk ORDER BY n DESC;

question_fa: آیا در دیتاست عمومی افراد با ریسک بالا، درمان‌جویی بیشتری دارند؟
sql: SELECT mental_health_risk, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(seeks_treatment) AS treatment_seekers, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(seeks_treatment) / COUNT(*), 2) AS treatment_rate_pct, ROUND(AVG(depression_score), 2) AS avg_depression, ROUND(AVG(anxiety_score), 2) AS avg_anxiety FROM mental_health_general GROUP BY mental_health_risk ORDER BY CASE mental_health_risk WHEN 'High' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END;

question_fa: روند شیوع افسردگی ایران همراه با تغییر نسبت به سال قبل چیست؟

question_fa: در هر محیط کاری، درصد افراد ریسک بالا چقدر است؟
sql: SELECT work_environment, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN mental_health_risk = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_risk_count, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN mental_health_risk = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS high_risk_rate_pct, ROUND(AVG(productivity_score), 2) AS avg_productivity FROM mental_health_general GROUP BY work_environment ORDER BY high_risk_rate_pct DESC;

question_fa: برای eating_disorder، کشورهایی که آخرین مقدارشان بالاتر از میانگین جهانی است را رتبه‌بندی کن.
sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT country_name, prevalence_pct FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE disorder = 'eating_disorder' AND is_country_like = 1 AND year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM country_prevalence_long)), avg_global AS (SELECT AVG(prevalence_pct) AS avg_value FROM latest) SELECT country_name, ROUND(prevalence_pct, 3) AS prevalence_pct, ROUND(avg_value, 3) AS global_avg, ROUND(prevalence_pct - avg_value, 3) AS gap_from_avg, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY prevalence_pct DESC) AS global_rank FROM latest CROSS JOIN avg_global WHERE prevalence_pct > avg_value ORDER BY global_rank LIMIT 30;

question_fa: در دیتاست عادت‌های دانشجویی، gender را با میانگین کل نمره امتحان مقایسه کن.
sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(exam_score) AS overall_avg_exam FROM student_habits_performance), grouped AS (SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS total, AVG(exam_score) AS avg_exam, AVG(mental_health_rating) AS avg_mental_health FROM student_habits_performance GROUP BY gender) SELECT gender, total, ROUND(avg_exam, 2) AS avg_exam_score, ROUND(overall_avg_exam, 2) AS overall_avg_exam, ROUND(avg_exam - overall_avg_exam, 2) AS exam_gap, ROUND(avg_mental_health, 2) AS avg_mental_health FROM grouped CROSS JOIN overall ORDER BY exam_gap DESC;

question_fa: روند شیوع افسردگی، اضطراب و اختلال دوقطبی در Japan را در طول زمان مقایسه کن.
sql: SELECT year, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN disorder = 'depression' THEN prevalence_pct END), 3) AS depression_pct, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN disorder = 'anxiety' THEN prevalence_pct END), 3) AS anxiety_pct, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN disorder = 'bipolar' THEN prevalence_pct END), 3) AS bipolar_pct FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE country_name = 'Japan' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;

question_fa: برای شهرهای با نمونه کافی، فشار تحصیلی رو رتبه‌بندی کن - نسخه 35.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(cgpa_10) AS avg_cgpa, AVG(academic_pressure) AS avg_pressure FROM student_depression WHERE city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY city HAVING COUNT(*)>=750) SELECT city, n, ROUND(avg_cgpa,2) AS avg_cgpa, ROUND(avg_pressure,2) AS avg_pressure, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_pressure DESC) AS pressure_rank FROM s ORDER BY pressure_rank LIMIT 12;

question_fa: در هر جنسیت، ۵ شهر با بیشترین نرخ افسردگی دانشجویان کدام‌اند؟
sql: WITH city_gender_rates AS (SELECT gender, city, COUNT(*) AS total, 100.0 * SUM(depression_flag) / COUNT(*) AS depression_rate_pct FROM student_depression GROUP BY gender, city HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY gender ORDER BY depression_rate_pct DESC) AS rn FROM city_gender_rates) SELECT gender, city, total, ROUND(depression_rate_pct, 2) AS depression_rate_pct FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY gender, depression_rate_pct DESC;

question_fa: ساعت کار/مطالعه رو چهارک کن و نرخ افسردگی هر چهارک رو بده.
sql: WITH q AS (SELECT work_study_hours, depression_flag, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY work_study_hours) AS work_study_quartile FROM student_depression WHERE work_study_hours IS NOT NULL AND depression_flag IS NOT NULL) SELECT work_study_quartile, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(work_study_hours),2) AS avg_work_study_hours, ROUND(100.0*SUM(depression_flag)/COUNT(*),2) AS depression_rate_pct FROM q GROUP BY work_study_quartile ORDER BY work_study_quartile;

question_fa: فشار مالی رو چهارک کن و نرخ افکار خودکشی رو aggregate بده.
sql: WITH q AS (SELECT financial_stress, suicidal_thoughts, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY financial_stress) AS financial_quartile FROM student_depression WHERE financial_stress IS NOT NULL AND suicidal_thoughts IS NOT NULL) SELECT financial_quartile, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(financial_stress),2) AS avg_financial_stress, ROUND(100.0*SUM(suicidal_thoughts)/COUNT(*),2) AS suicidal_rate_pct FROM q GROUP BY financial_quartile ORDER BY financial_quartile;

question_fa: کشورها را بر اساس تغییر شیوع depression از ۱۹۹۰ تا آخرین سال رتبه‌بندی کن.
sql: WITH endpoints AS (SELECT country_name, MAX(CASE WHEN year = 1990 THEN prevalence_pct END) AS value_1990, MAX(CASE WHEN year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM country_prevalence_long) THEN prevalence_pct END) AS value_latest FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE disorder = 'depression' AND is_country_like = 1 GROUP BY country_name), changes AS (SELECT country_name, value_1990, value_latest, value_latest - value_1990 AS change_pct_point FROM endpoints WHERE value_1990 IS NOT NULL AND value_latest IS NOT NULL) SELECT country_name, ROUND(value_1990, 3) AS value_1990, ROUND(value_latest, 3) AS value_latest, ROUND(change_pct_point, 3) AS change_pct_point, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY change_pct_point DESC) AS increase_rank FROM changes ORDER BY increase_rank LIMIT 25;

question_fa: برای شروع داشبورد دانشجوها KPIهای اصلی رو پشت سر هم بده.
sql: SELECT 'total_students' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM student_depression UNION ALL SELECT 'depression_rate_pct', ROUND(100.0*SUM(depression_flag)/COUNT(*),2) FROM student_depression UNION ALL SELECT 'avg_cgpa_10', ROUND(AVG(cgpa_10),2) FROM student_depression UNION ALL SELECT 'avg_academic_pressure', ROUND(AVG(academic_pressure),2) FROM student_depression;
storytelling_hint_fa: این query برای سنجش توان مدل در CTE/window/subquery مناسب است.

question_fa: برای داده جهانی KPIهای تعداد کشور، سال و میانگین افسردگی و اضطراب رو بده.
sql: SELECT 'locations' AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT country_name) AS value FROM country_prevalence_long UNION ALL SELECT 'years', COUNT(DISTINCT year) FROM country_prevalence_long UNION ALL SELECT 'avg_depression', ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN disorder='depression' THEN prevalence_pct END),4) FROM country_prevalence_long UNION ALL SELECT 'avg_anxiety', ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN disorder='anxiety' THEN prevalence_pct END),4) FROM country_prevalence_long;
storytelling_hint_fa: این query برای سنجش توان مدل در CTE/window/subquery مناسب است.

question_fa: روند شیوع افسردگی، اضطراب و اختلال دوقطبی در Netherlands را در طول زمان مقایسه کن.
sql: SELECT year, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN disorder = 'depression' THEN prevalence_pct END), 3) AS depression_pct, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN disorder = 'anxiety' THEN prevalence_pct END), 3) AS anxiety_pct, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN disorder = 'bipolar' THEN prevalence_pct END), 3) AS bipolar_pct FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE country_name = 'Netherlands' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;

question_fa: دسته‌های خواب از نظر نرخ افسردگی چه وضعی دارن؟
sql: SELECT sleep_duration_category AS group_value, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(depression_flag) AS positives, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(depression_flag) / COUNT(*), 2) AS rate_pct, ROUND(AVG(cgpa_10),2) AS avg_cgpa_10 FROM student_depression WHERE sleep_duration_category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sleep_duration_category  ORDER BY rate_pct DESC LIMIT 15;
storytelling_hint_fa: نرخ را همراه تعداد نمونه نشان بده تا مقایسه گمراه‌کننده نشود.

question_fa: میانگین افسردگی و اضطراب بر اساس سطح ریسک سلامت روان عمومی چقدر است؟
sql: SELECT mental_health_risk, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(AVG(depression_score), 2) AS avg_depression_score, ROUND(AVG(anxiety_score), 2) AS avg_anxiety_score, ROUND(AVG(productivity_score), 2) AS avg_productivity FROM mental_health_general GROUP BY mental_health_risk ORDER BY avg_depression_score DESC;

question_fa: میانگین بهره‌وری بر اساس سطح استرس در دیتاست عمومی چقدر است؟
sql: SELECT stress_level, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(AVG(productivity_score), 2) AS avg_productivity, ROUND(AVG(depression_score), 2) AS avg_depression_score FROM mental_health_general GROUP BY stress_level ORDER BY stress_level;

question_fa: نرخ افسردگی دانشجویان را به تفکیک جنسیت و گروه سنی مقایسه کن.
sql:
SELECT
    gender,
    CASE
        WHEN age < 22 THEN 'Under 22'
        WHEN age < 26 THEN '22-25'
        ELSE '26+'
    END AS age_group,
    COUNT(*) AS total,
    SUM(depression_flag) AS depressed,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(depression_flag) / COUNT(*), 2) AS depression_rate_pct
FROM student_depression
WHERE age IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY gender, age_group
ORDER BY gender, depression_rate_pct DESC;
storytelling_hint_fa: برای روایت، ابتدا تفاوت جنسیت‌ها را نشان بده و سپس توضیح بده کدام گروه سنی در هر جنسیت ریسک بالاتری دارد.

question_fa: میانگین افسردگی و بهره‌وری دیتاست عمومی به تفکیک وضعیت اشتغال چقدر است؟
sql: SELECT employment_status, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(AVG(depression_score), 2) AS avg_depression_score, ROUND(AVG(productivity_score), 2) AS avg_productivity_score FROM mental_health_general GROUP BY employment_status ORDER BY avg_depression_score DESC;

question_fa: میانگین نمره امتحان دانشجویان در دسته‌های خواب مختلف چقدر است؟
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN sleep_hours < 5 THEN '<5h' WHEN sleep_hours < 7 THEN '5-7h' WHEN sleep_hours < 9 THEN '7-9h' ELSE '9h+' END AS sleep_bucket, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(AVG(exam_score), 2) AS avg_exam_score, ROUND(AVG(mental_health_rating), 2) AS avg_mental_health_rating FROM student_habits_performance GROUP BY sleep_bucket ORDER BY MIN(sleep_hours);

question_fa: فعالیت فوق‌برنامه با نمره و ساعت مطالعه چطور مقایسه میشه؟
sql: SELECT extracurricular_participation AS group_value, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(exam_score),2) AS avg_exam_score, ROUND(AVG(mental_health_rating),2) AS avg_mental_health_rating, ROUND(AVG(sleep_hours),2) AS avg_sleep_hours FROM student_habits_performance GROUP BY extracurricular_participation ORDER BY avg_exam_score DESC;
storytelling_hint_fa: عملکرد و سلامت روان را در یک نمای مقایسه‌ای نشان بده.

question_fa: محیط کاری حضوری/ریموت/هیبرید از نظر ریسک High چه فرقی داره؟
sql: SELECT work_environment AS group_value, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN mental_health_risk='High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) AS high_risk_rate_pct FROM mental_health_general GROUP BY work_environment ORDER BY high_risk_rate_pct DESC;
storytelling_hint_fa: شاخص‌های عمومی را با گروه‌بندی خوانا روایت کن.

question_fa: میانگین رتبه سلامت روان به تفکیک internet_quality چقدر است؟
sql: SELECT internet_quality, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(AVG(mental_health_rating), 2) AS avg_mental_health_rating FROM student_habits_performance WHERE internet_quality IS NOT NULL GROUP BY internet_quality ORDER BY avg_mental_health_rating DESC;

question_fa: work_interfere با treatment rate چطور تغییر میکنه؟
sql: SELECT work_interfere AS group_value, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(100.0*SUM(treatment)/COUNT(*),2) AS treatment_rate_pct FROM workplace_mental_health_survey WHERE work_interfere IS NOT NULL GROUP BY work_interfere  ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 15;
storytelling_hint_fa: برای سیاست سازمانی نرخ‌ها بهتر از تعداد خام هستند.

question_fa: در هر وضعیت اشتغال، چند درصد دنبال درمان هستن؟
sql: SELECT employment_status AS group_value, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(100.0*SUM(seeks_treatment)/COUNT(*),2) AS treatment_seeking_rate_pct, ROUND(AVG(stress_level),2) AS avg_stress FROM mental_health_general WHERE seeks_treatment IS NOT NULL GROUP BY employment_status ORDER BY treatment_seeking_rate_pct DESC;
storytelling_hint_fa: شاخص‌های عمومی را با گروه‌بندی خوانا روایت کن.

question_fa: میانگین شیوع جهانی depression به تفکیک سال چیست؟
sql: SELECT year, ROUND(AVG(prevalence_pct), 3) AS avg_depression_prevalence_pct FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE disorder = 'depression' AND is_country_like = 1 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;

question_fa: میانگین افسردگی بر اساس تعداد روزهای فعالیت فیزیکی در هفته چقدر است؟
sql: SELECT physical_activity_days, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(AVG(depression_score), 2) AS avg_depression_score, ROUND(AVG(anxiety_score), 2) AS avg_anxiety_score FROM mental_health_general GROUP BY physical_activity_days ORDER BY physical_activity_days;

question_fa: نرخ اضطراب در نظرسنجی دانشگاهی به تفکیک سال تحصیل چقدر است؟
sql: SELECT year_of_study, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(anxiety_diagnosis) AS anxiety_count, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(anxiety_diagnosis) / COUNT(*), 2) AS anxiety_rate_pct FROM university_student_mental_health GROUP BY year_of_study ORDER BY year_of_study;

question_fa: نرخ افسردگی دانشگاهی برای دانشجویان متأهل و مجرد چقدر است؟
sql: SELECT marital_status, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(depression_diagnosis) AS depressed_count, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(depression_diagnosis) / COUNT(*), 2) AS depression_rate_pct FROM university_student_mental_health GROUP BY marital_status ORDER BY depression_rate_pct DESC;
